name: Phenotype-Similar-Distractor-Variant-Rare-Disease-Cohort-n1047
alternateName: A Phenotype-Similar Distractor Variant of the Stratified Rare-Disease Cohort for Literature-Based Causal Gene Prioritisation (n=1,047)
description: A HARD variant of the stratified rare-disease benchmark cohort. It contains the same 1,047 rare-disease cases as the standard cohort (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.32814449) - identical case_id, causal_gene, hpo_terms, diseases, and the same deconfounding layer - but the 49 distractor genes per case are PHENOTYPICALLY SIMILAR to the case rather than randomly sampled. Similarity is HPO Resnik term similarity aggregated by best-match-average (BMA) between the case HPO profile and each gene's known HPO annotations (the Phenomizer/Exomiser-standard measure); information content is computed from genes_to_phenotype.txt propagated over the hp.obo is-a DAG. Candidates are HGNC protein-coding genes carrying HPO annotations, excluding the causal gene and any gene annotated to the case's own causal disease(s) (so no distractor is a curated alternative cause for that diagnosis); the top-49 by BMA are selected (ties broken by symbol) and the 50-gene list is shuffled with the same per-case seed as the standard cohort (BLAKE2b(global_seed=42 | case_id)). This turns distractor difficulty into an explicit experimental axis, orthogonal to the annotation-overlap (leakage) axis, enabling a 2x2 difficulty x leakage evaluation.
citeAs: @dataset{angulo2026rd_cohort_hard, author = {Angulo, Johanna}, title = {A Phenotype-Similar Distractor Variant of the Stratified Rare-Disease Cohort for Literature-Based Causal Gene Prioritisation (n=1,047)}, year = {2026}, publisher = {Figshare}, version = {v1.0}, doi = {10.6084/m9.figshare.32816468}, note = {Case-paired with the standard variant DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.32814449; CC BY 4.0.}}
rai:dataCollection: Not primary data collection. The 1,047 cases are exactly those of the standard GenoAgent cohort (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.32814449), themselves selected from GA4GH Phenopacket Store v0.1.26. Only the 49 distractor genes per case differ: here they are chosen to be phenotypically SIMILAR to the case rather than random.
rai:dataCollectionType: Curated/derived benchmark: a case-paired hard-negative variant of an existing derived cohort. Not a population sample and not primary clinical data.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels (causal_gene, hpo_terms, diseases) are inherited byte-for-byte from the standard cohort. Hard distractors are selected by HPO Resnik term similarity aggregated by best-match-average (BMA) between the case HPO profile and each gene's HPO annotations (information content from genes_to_phenotype.txt propagated over the hp.obo is-a DAG). The candidate pool is HGNC protein-coding genes carrying HPO annotations, EXCLUDING the causal gene and any gene annotated to the case's own causal disease(s) so no distractor is a curated alternative cause for that diagnosis; the top-49 by BMA are taken (ties broken by gene symbol) and the 50-gene list is shuffled with the same per-case seed as the standard cohort (BLAKE2b(global_seed=42 | case_id)).
rai:dataUseCases: Intended to stress-test differential-diagnosis behaviour of literature-based / retrieval-augmented causal gene prioritization systems, and to pair with the standard cohort for a 2x2 difficulty x leakage evaluation. NOT intended for clinical decision-making or diagnosis.
rai:dataBiases: Distractor difficulty is deliberately elevated (phenotype-similar hard negatives), so absolute accuracy is not comparable to the random-distractor standard cohort - compare the two only as paired conditions. The annotation-overlap (leakage) bias of the underlying cases is unchanged (approximately 73% overlap); use the annotation_overlap.json fair subset for unbiased comparison.
rai:dataLimitations: One causal gene per case; distractors are protein-coding HGNC genes carrying HPO annotations only. Similarity depends on the completeness of gene-to-HPO annotations, so poorly annotated genes are under-represented among distractors. Derived and seeded: a reproducible evaluation set, not a disease-population sample.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No direct identifiers. Content is limited to phenotype (HPO), disease (OMIM/MONDO), and gene (HGNC) terms plus a source-publication reference, all derived from already-published, openly licensed case reports. No raw clinical records, images, or genomic sequence are included.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Versioned on Figshare under a persistent DOI (this item is v1.0), case-paired to the standard cohort DOI. Regenerates from pinned public inputs plus the methods/foundation code (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.32814491, stage 18b); every file's SHA-256 is pinned in CHECKSUMS.sha256.

isBasedOn.name: Stratified rare-disease benchmark cohort (standard, random distractors)

distribution.name: test_cases_hard.jsonl
distribution.description: Canonical hard cohort: one JSON object per case (1,047 rows); same schema as the standard cohort plus candidate_difficulty.

distribution.name: annotation_overlap.json
distribution.description: Per-case annotation-overlap flags plus meta (cohort overlap rate). Deconfounding sidecar for the fair-subset (leakage) axis.

recordSet.name: cases
recordSet.description: One benchmark case per record. The prediction task is to rank candidate_genes so that causal_gene appears at the top; the ground-truth position is causal_gene_index_in_candidates. Distractors here are phenotype-similar hard negatives.

field.name: case_id
field.description: Stable case ID, '{CAUSAL_GENE}:{phenopacket_id}'. Identical to the matching case in the standard cohort.

field.name: category
field.description: Disease category: one of developmental | immunological | metabolic | neurological.

field.name: hpo_terms
field.description: Patient phenotype as Human Phenotype Ontology term IDs (HP:NNNNNNN); at least 3 per case.

field.name: diseases
field.description: Associated disease(s): a repeated record of {id, label}. id is typically an OMIM CURIE (OMIM:NNNNNN); label is the disease name.

field.name: causal_gene
field.description: HGNC symbol of the true causal gene (the prediction target).

field.name: candidate_genes
field.description: 50 HGNC symbols to rank: the causal gene plus 49 phenotype-similar (Resnik-BMA top-49) hard-negative distractors.

field.name: causal_gene_index_in_candidates
field.description: 0-based index of causal_gene within candidate_genes (ground-truth label position).

field.name: pmc_article_count
field.description: Number of PMC Open Access articles mentioning the causal gene (coverage; at least 5 by construction). Identical to the standard cohort.

field.name: source_phenopacket
field.description: Relative path to the source phenopacket JSON within GA4GH Phenopacket Store v0.1.26.

field.name: candidate_difficulty
field.description: Marks the distractor regime for this variant; constant value 'hard' (phenotype-similar distractors).
